question.text: A decimolar solution potassium ferrocyanide is $50 \%$ dissociated at 300 K . The osmotic pressure of solution is $\left(R=8.314 \mathrm{JK}^{-1} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}\right)$

solution.text: $\alpha=0.5$ (50\% dissociated) The reaction involves is Total moles at equilibrium $=1-\alpha+4 \alpha+\alpha$ $\text { Total }=1+4 \alpha$ $\therefore$ van't Hoff factor $(i)=\frac{1+4 \alpha}{1}=1+4 \times 0.5=3$ Osmotic pressure, $\pi=i C R T$ $\begin{aligned} C & =0.1 \mathrm{M}=10^2 \mathrm{~mol} \mathrm{~m}^{-3} \\ \pi & =3 \times 10^2 \times 8.314 \times 300 \\ & =7.483 \times 10^5 \mathrm{Nm}^{-2} \end{aligned}$ or $\pi=7.48 \mathrm{~atm}$
